data.name: Shard Explosion
data.description: As a swift action, you can cause jagged pieces of stone to explode outward from your body. These shards deal %1d6 points of piercing damage to all creatures within a 10-foot burst. A Reflex save (DC %2) halves this damage. In addition, the broken shards make the area difficult terrain until your next turn. You can use this ability %3 Time(s) per day.|OracleShardExplosionDamageDice|OracleRevelationDC|OracleShardExplosionTimes
